node.statement: Threshold choice: let e_cmp > 0 be the universal constant supplied by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities, and set e_var := e_cmp. For every H-CB datum with e <= e_var, that external applies at every n >= 1 to P,R,Q and guarantees that the amplified compression maps used in the compressed products are idempotent and adjoint-compatible. Thus e_var is universal and positive, and all products and daggers below have the stated amplified corner types.
